requirements.summary: Use DeepSeek Harness as the software-delivery orchestration runtime.
Enable an agent to ingest evidence, implement from specifications, verify, and deliver software.
Use OpenAI models through DeepSeek Harness and price OpenAI usage.
Track and map model cost to every repository change.
Keep the complete delivery engine in a separate project directory on the main branch.
Reuse one engine to develop multiple independently specified projects such as catalog consolidation.
Provide a reusable portable SDD-history exporter and validator with safe semantic capture, provenance, exclusion accounting, cost reporting, and clean-clone verification.

Ensure reusable SDD delivery survives provider rate-limit interruptions with bounded, cost-aware, resumable retries and explicitly authorized Terra-to-Luna fallback without affecting the deterministic model-free catalog runtime.
Repair the failing main-branch CI caused by the README template commit and preserve the two generated public presentation PDFs without weakening private-source or cost-trailer enforcement.
Validate agent output, preserve traceability, and enforce offline release gates.
